other_conditions: Must be a native of Puducherry Union Territory or have continuous residence there for the past three years.
Candidates who have already received training under this scheme are not eligible.
Applications must be submitted directly to the General Manager, District Industries Centre, Pondicherry, not through any organization or association.
Applicant must not be receiving financial assistance from any other source, as certified by the District Collector/Dy. Commissioner.
benefits_summary: Trainees receive a stipend of Rs.1,500 per month, while trainers get an honorarium up to Rs.3,000 per month and raw material compensation up to Rs.2,000 per month.
documents_required: Certificate from the District Collector/Dy. Commissioner certifying financial position and confirming no other financial assistance
Age certificate from the appropriate authority
Affidavit before a First Class Magistrate regarding income and age (alternative to the above certificates)
application_link: The District Industries Centre shall release an advertisement in local daily newspapers thereby inviting applications from eligible applicants. Step 1: Application will be called through wide publicity every year. Applicant should apply in the prescribed form to this office directly addressed to the General Manager, District Industries Centre, Pondicherry -9. Any application received through any organization or association will not be accepted. Step 2: Request a hard copy of the proforma from the concerned authority. Step 3: Applications should be duly supported by the following documents. A certificate from the District Collector/ Dy. Commissioner certifies the financial position of the applicant including a certificate that the applicant is not in receipt of financial assistance from any other source. Age certificate from the appropriate authority. OR Required certificates in respect of income and age mentioned above can also be furnished by the craftsperson himself/ herself in the form of an affidavit declared before a First class Magistrate. Step 4: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the General Manager, District Industries Centre, Pondicherry. Contact officer: The Technical Officer, Yanam.
